judge.label: LLM rubric score, fresh-context judge, self-assessed — not human QA.
judge.independence_caveat: This judge is a different model family and a fresh context: it saw only the judge prompt, the rubric and the lesson. It did not direct the project and did not author anything in it. It is still a language model scoring a language model's output, so the label applies: not human QA.

notes.knowledge_check: Two of the four options in KC-01 and KC-02 restate the stem or are implausible distractors (e.g., promising a refund without authority). Feedback is generally strong, but some options fail to name misconceptions.

verdict_notes: One criterion at 3 (knowledge_check), mean score 4.25. Passes. The knowledge checks are the weakest part, with some distractors that are either implausible or restate the stem.
